reasons: Integrity verified before judging: candidate.json hashes to 60fe26b9acbd5e210f642bd3393dfe23a0b9c014c564c541a9dd41b29b31187b as stated, and the candidate embedded in A10.input.json is deep-equal to those bytes. mirror_brief is null, so the mirror was constructed from the same four sources with the lean flipped: the recorded fall reads as money displaced off the monitored rails rather than a market contraction.

Edge statuses symmetric. counts.supported is 0, so the specific leak of marking the artifact's own framing supported on evidence the mirror would be denied is structurally absent. jt-e1-crackdown-to-fall stays unsourced even though the Kompas member headline places the fall 'di era Prabowo', which a lenient artifact would have banked as support. jt-e2-fall-to-read sits at unsourced rather than missing, and that softer status is earned by an actual member headline (CNBC 'Tersisa Rp286,84 T') performing the read; the mirror's equivalent step has no headline performing it and would land at missing. jt-e3-read-to-outcome is missing, matching the mirror's terminal step.

Hidden branch count symmetric. Seven branches surface against the framing; constructing the mirror surfaces seven to eight equivalents, because jt-h1-two-series-gap, jt-h2-recording-coverage, jt-h4-prior-trajectory, jt-h5-quarter-baseline and jt-h7-operator-outflow are lean-neutral record gaps that recur unchanged on the displacement side. jt-h1 in particular cuts harder at the mirror than at the framing, since the mirror must explain a 30 percent fall in net deposits, and the card states it without directing the inference either way.

Depth equal across the two competing measures. jt-panel-dueling gives jt-duel-turnover-2024/2025 and jt-duel-deposits-2024/2025 identical method lines of the same specificity, both years for both series, and rule_line protects the deposit series from being folded into or displaced by turnover. The strongest pro-framing datum, net deposits falling faster (Rp51.3T to Rp36.01T, steeper than turnover's Rp359.81T to Rp286.84T), is on the page in full in both languages (narration.en v-5, narration.id v-6) and is never discounted. Neither percentage is computed, so no side gets arithmetic the other is denied.

Language temperature cool and even. Full-string scan of all 364 strings returns no C1 verdict word in either language; 'salah' and 'benar' do not occur at all, so there is no lexicon false positive to report either. No em dashes, no en dashes, no emoji; every apostrophe hit is a possessive, not a scare quote. The artifact never uses a verb of saying, so there is no says/claims or says/admits asymmetry available to leak.

Burden of proof not one-sided. Of three sparring questions only 'mechanism' loads the framing; 'denominator' actively vindicates the framing's comparison as one series correctly used ('The scale check sets both figures in one series'), and 'incidence' is neutral measurement literacy. No narration sentence asks PPATK or the government to explain itself; the copy reports only what the family of articles does and does not carry.

Change 1 holds and fixes in the right direction. narration.en v-6 now reads 'the channels that would carry what the blocked rails lose', carrying the same conditional as jt-h3-displaced-channels why_hidden.en. The narration no longer asserts in the artifact's own voice that displacement is occurring, which was the one place a mirror-side thesis was stated factively at a higher confidence than any of the framing's own steps, all of which are unsourced or missing. The orchestrator's 'verbatim' is slightly imprecise (card: 'the flow the blocked rails lose'; narration: 'what the blocked rails lose'), but the operative modal is identical and the semantics match; not a defect. The residual presupposition that the blocked rails lose something is uncontested, since both readings agree recorded volume fell.

Change 2 holds. narration.id v-4 now reads 'porsi pasar yang terjangkau alat pencatat', dropping 'masih', which had smuggled in a direction of travel (coverage shrinking over time) that the jt-h2-recording-coverage card does not carry. The remaining difference from the card label is the dropped 'PPATK' attributive, a compression rather than a strengthening, and the panel label carries the attribution.

Structural integrity intact after both edits. All 26 el_ids bind in both languages with no danglers and no element surfaced in one language only; every edge, hidden card, chip, spine node, dueling count and panel appears in both narrations. Stored counts recompute exactly per contracts/types.ts:235-239 (missing 1, unsourced 7 = 2 unsourced edges plus 5 hidden entries without ev, disputed 0, supported 0, hidden 7, conflicts 4).

One asymmetry candidate examined and rejected as non-blocking: jt-h2-recording-coverage why_hidden contains the artifact's only flat indicative, 'A push that blocks accounts and payment channels also changes where transactions run' (id: 'juga mengubah tempat transaksi berjalan'), where a modal would be more careful. It is near-analytic, since blocking a rail changes the set of rails transactions run through whether they redirect or stop; it asserts no volume; the card's actual question is explicitly conditional ('whether the recording base ... stayed constant'); and it reads identically in both languages, so it is not a bilingual leak. Not grounds to send a run back.
